objective: Complete the original OmniPlay product source in items 1 through 16; Antigravity executes assigned tests while Codex reviews evidence and decides fixes
progress_policy: Follow numbered items 1 through 16 in order and report completed items; distinguish authored source from verified completion

requirements.description: Maintained Chromium fork with real desktop and Android integration, reproducible builds and minimal patch queue
Browser UX, private profiles, permissions, library and safe gaming mode
Versioned IPC, capability broker, isolated runtime lifecycle and local library
Controller, keyboard, touch, audio, video, fullscreen and device lifecycle
Licensed NES GB GBC SNES GBA adapters and advanced retro integrations specified for v1
Atomic saves, history, recovery, compatibility and account-independent import/export
Real device probes, metrics overlay, benchmark runner and bounded performance profiles
Android Chromium product with store-appropriate distribution and lifecycle
iOS WebKit product with shared capabilities, controls and store-appropriate runtime paths
Authenticated host pairing, installed-game bridge, remote video/audio/input, reconnect and QoS
Local rules, runtime ranking, guarded configuration and optional assistant without render-path interference
Opt-in account and encrypted save synchronization with conflict preservation and revocation
Signing, trust, secure updater, supply-chain inventory, fuzz targets and incident controls
One final comprehensive verification with real platform and compatibility evidence
Accurate pinned dependency/core license inventory, distribution policy and content handling

progress_basis: Numbered source items and actual final evidence; the historical authoring estimate is not a measured completion percentage
